results.headline: JPMorgan Raises Full-Year Net Interest Income Guidance to $92.5B
results.body: JPMorgan Chase raised its full-year net interest income guidance to approximately $92.5 billion, up from its prior guidance of $91 billion. The revision reflects higher-for-longer interest rates and strong loan growth. Analysts viewed the revision positively as it signals confidence in the bank's core earnings power.

results.headline: JPMorgan Q3 Net Income Rises 35% on Higher Interest Income
results.body: JPMorgan Chase reported Q3 2024 net income of $12.9 billion, up 35% from a year earlier, driven by rising net interest income and strong investment banking fees. Revenue of $43.3 billion beat analyst expectations of $41.8 billion. CEO Jamie Dimon warned of geopolitical risks and potential credit deterioration ahead.

tool_outputs.query: Did JPMorgan raise its net interest income outlook? What was reported?

answer:
According to the news article [Source: news-jpm-002], JPMorgan Chase raised its full-year net interest income guidance to approximately $92.5 billion, up from its prior guidance of $91 billion.

This revision reflects higher-for-longer interest rates and strong loan growth, which analysts viewed positively as a signal of confidence in the bank's core earnings power [Source: news-jpm-002].

In Q3 2024, JPMorgan reported net income of $12.9 billion, up 35% from a year earlier, driven by rising net interest income and strong investment banking fees [Source: news-jpm-001].
